name: hardened-banking-platform
description: Hardened Banking Platform Monorepo — Single centralized .env via dotenvx

scripts.dev:db: bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d database"
scripts.dev: npm run env:check && npm run dev:db && concurrently --names "backend,web,mobile" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.docker:build: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml build"
scripts.docker:up: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --build"
scripts.docker:down: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down"
scripts.docker:logs: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml logs -f"
scripts.docker:config: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml config"
scripts.docker:restart: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml restart"
scripts.docker:prod:up: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml up -d --build"
scripts.docker:prod:down: bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml down"
scripts.docker:prod:restart: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd infra/docker && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml restart"
